comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
In honor of Atlantis' brief return... stats on this item.

Durability: 60
Defense: 58
Evasion +2
Swordplay +1
Assault +1
50k total fame to equip.

Obtained from the Two-horned Great King opponent, one of two Ancient Ganadors who can always be accessed once you've done the Egypt and Atlantis quest in the Atlantis chain (Atlantis does not have to be in-game for them to appear). Ancient Ganadors appear randomly at the Command Center once you've beaten specific regular Ganadors, or can be summoned with an Apollo Torch item.

This can be upgraded with Transmutation Alchemy to EX form. Its EX Effect is: Increase Melee Capabilities R3
